events.signup: Made an account. Props: role (student, parent)
events.session_started: Started a practice session. Props: kind (practice, daily, mistakes, competition, placement)
events.session_completed: Answered the last question of a session. Props: kind (practice, daily, mistakes, competition, placement)
events.duel_started: Opened or joined a live duel. Props: matched (now, waiting)
events.duel_finished: A duel ended for this player; sent by the browser when the result is in. Props: result (win, loss, draw)
events.problem_reported: Reported a problem as wrong or unclear. Props: reason, from (practice, duel)
events.problem_suggested: Proposed a problem for the bank. Props: answer_type (multiple_choice, exact_value)
events.competition_joined: Said they will enter a competition. Props: competition (its slug)
